The most appropriate ground is **Speech or Debate Clause immunity** (U.S. Const. art. I, §6, cl. 1). A floor speech is a core legislative act, so it is absolutely protected from civil liability, and the suit fails whether or not the accusation was false or negligent. The actual-malice pleading gap is a weaker, secondary ground that would matter only if the clause did not apply.

CONFIDENCE: 82
